# AOTriton 0.13b on gfx1100

Matrix-core TFLOPS from the median time; only the two matmuls count, so dropout shows as lower TFLOPS. Prime cells give the bf16 TFLOPS of the unforced operator, and the fp16 difference in parentheses. `—`: excluded (not supported, or does not fit the GPU). `✗`: measured, no data. Blank: not measured.

The unforced operator is what users get, measured as it is: it can be slower than its fastest forced backend, because the operator database's choice is not corrected.

- device 0x75a0, 288 GiB, 8 GPUs per node, thermal gate off; Test CPU, Debian 13, kernel 6.12; ROCm 10.1.0; measured 2026-11-01
